name: Marianne
source:
Crown Princess of the Kingdom of Granache

As heir apparent to the throne, Marianne spends her days preparing for her future role as Queen of Granache. Tutored in both practical and ceremonial matters, she is afforded precious little free time to do what she wants.

On the surface, Marianne is the ideal Princess: beautiful, delicate, and proper. But those who actually get past this paper-thin facade quickly learn that she's not exactly the most pleasant person to be around most of the time.

Especially not towards total strangers who suddenly impose upon her life.
